tradeoff: Every viewer's Jellyfin app goes; Octave becomes the only client.
entry: The owner: abandon Jellyfin parity and make jellyscale new software for a private collection of films and shows for a household, friends and family, or a community ("we are putting Jellyfin in the rear view mirror and thinking of this as a net new piece of software"). Octave need not work with Jellyfin servers; no 'keep your apps' promise; stop checking behaviour against Jellyfin. Better playback first, with storage a constraint: the original on top, a handful of steps, 720p the usual floor, 480p where the content suits it. Offline viewing second. A short time without a working client is acceptable, but Octave must always have something to build against. A clean cutover: Octave adapts; first get Octave fetching films and TV and starting playback. Never music or photo libraries.
